**local-infrastructure**: Docker Compose v2+ .NET 8 development stack: MS SQL Server 2025, PostgreSQL 16, Azure Service Bus Emulator; managed by PowerShell 5.1+ `stack.ps1`. No CI/CD pipelines or test infrastructure.

Files: `.env.example`, `.env`, `.gitignore`, `docker-compose.yml`, `stack.ps1`, `README.md`, `Config.example.json`, `Config.json`, `Program.cs`, `ServiceBusMonitor.csproj`; monitor directory: `cd servicebus/monitor`.

.\stack.ps1 start
.\stack.ps1 stop
.\stack.ps1 restart
.\stack.ps1 nuke
.\stack.ps1 status
.\stack.ps1 logs [service]
.\stack.ps1 pull
.\stack.ps1 monitor
docker compose up -d
docker compose down
docker compose down -v

Copy `.env.example` → `.env` and fill in all placeholder values. **Never commit `.env`** (it is in `.gitignore`).
**Never commit `.env` or `servicebus/Config.json`** — both contain local configuration and are git-ignored.
**Password complexity** — SQL Server passwords must meet: min 8 characters, mixed case, at least one digit, at least one special character.
**Service Bus depends on its internal SQL Server** — `servicebus` starts only after `servicebus-sql` is healthy.
**Maintain TUI consistency** — `stack.ps1` and `Program.cs` share a visual style; preserve it in any changes.
**Volumes persist across restarts** — only `.\stack.ps1 nuke` or `docker compose down -v` removes them.
**PowerShell 5.1+ compatibility** — do not introduce syntax that requires PowerShell 7+ (e.g. ternary operators, null-coalescing, pipeline chain operators, multi-argument `Join-Path`).
**Keep `.env.example` and `Config.example.json` in sync** — if you add new environment variables to `docker-compose.yml`, add them to `.env.example` with placeholder values and document them in `README.md`. Changes to Service Bus entities should be reflected in `Config.example.json`.

Every service must have a `healthcheck` block.
Secrets come from `.env` via environment variable substitution with defaults: `${VAR:-default}`.
Named volumes for any persistent data. Comment headers for each service section.
No secrets in source — `.env` is git-ignored.

`local-mssql`: 1433; `local-postgres`: 5432; `local-servicebus-sql`: internal; `local-servicebus`: 5672/5300, host-probed via `/health`. All use `restart: unless-stopped`. `.env` variables: `MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD`, `MSSQL_PORT`, `POSTGRES_USER`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `POSTGRES_DB`, `POSTGRES_PORT`, `SERVICEBUS_SQL_PASSWORD`, `SERVICEBUS_PORT`, `SERVICEBUS_MGMT_PORT`.
